test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_TUVTR_WU_UXVN_Y
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _TUVTR_WU_UXVN_Y

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) SUUP → __S__TUV / TR__U__W / U__U__UX / VN__P__Y

**Option 2) SUPU**** →** __**S**__TUV / TR__**U**__W / U__**P**__UX / VN__**U**__Y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dbec9db00ba5a0f287a0b52f28abc6d2efdfdda5961e28babf2840560ec2c71.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/000781db66233cca01ce2c8c1346b95127b2b6e89615373e1f170637907b4b30.png] 

Option 3) SVUP → __S__TUV / TR__V__W / U__U__UX / VN__P__Y

Option 4) PSVU → __P__TUV / TR__S__W / U__V__UX / VN__U__Y

Hence, the correct answer is "SUPU".
